import html # Predefined HTML template for the invitation. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_name} - Invitation
{event_name}
Date: {date_of_event}
{description_of_event}
{notes_for_event}
You are invited to {event_name}.
""" def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Args: event_name: Title of the event. description_of_event: Detailed description (may contain newlines). date_of_event: Scheduled date for the event. notes_for_event: Extra instructions or information. Returns: A string containing safe, escaped HTML suitable for rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent injection safe_event_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True) # Populate the template invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=safe_event_name, description_of_event=safe_description, date_of_event=safe_date, notes_for_event=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
